INT. PHOTO STUDIO – DAY1 1

Flashes shine throughout the room. LUCAS (singer, superstar) is shirtless as water drips down his abs into the waistband of his jeans. PHOTOGRAPHER(snapping, shouting)Perfect! One more! CREW MEMBER AWith Luca's shoot, the magazine’s numbers will blow past a million. CREW MEMBER BHis last album already hit a million, and now he’s booked for the Super Bowl halftime show. Guy’s untouchable right now!
INT. DRESSING ROOM – DAY2 2

EMILY (manager, single mom) struggles in, couture in one hand, three iced Americanos in the other, a call sheet wedged under her arm. ASSISTANT A(poking her shoulder)Emily! The Dior suit’s wrinkled. I want it pressed in ten minutes! Emily nods and starts handing things off to the stars. ASSISTANT B(throws her a set of keys)And move the trailer from the garage to the side door. ASSISTANT C(shoves towels in her arms)Floor’s covered in hairspray. Mop it while you’re at it. EMILY(exhausted, nodding)Got it… got it… From outside, a MANAGER bellows.
MANAGER (O.S.)Emily! Where the hell are you? Did you print out the contract? Is the inventory list ready? Emily rushes out of the dressing room.
INT. RECORD LABEL – DAY3 3

Lucas throws on a shirt, buttons only halfway. DAVID, the company CEO, hurries up and slaps his shoulder. DAVIDLucas! You rejected all seven managers the company assigned you! What are you looking for? LUCAS(lazy, unconcerned)What’s the rush? Haven’t found the right fit. DAVIDYou’re the top star in the country! You need someone to manage your calendar, book events, and clean up your messes! David tosses down paparazzi photos of Lucas flipping off photographers. Lucas picks one up and admires it. LUCASIsn't he just most handsome man alive? Come on, David, don’t be so mad. Lucas steps into the elevator and waves. LUCAS (CONT'D)Relax. I'll tell you by sunset.
INT. HALLWAY – DAY4 4

Emily races down the hall, barely able to see over the stack of files and a gown in her arms. EMILYExcuse me! Coming through! ANNA, arm-in-arm with MARK, deliberately knocks into her. Papers scatter everywhere.

ANNAWell, well. Emily. Look at you now that Mark’s left you. Emily scrambles to pick up her things. Anna steps closer, heel pinning Emily’s shoe, showing off a diamond necklace. ANNA (CONT'D)Mark bought me this. Gorgeous, isn't it? And you can’t even afford your kid's class trip. She must be so disappointed in you. Emily rises, teeth clenched. EMILYYou dropped two grand on a necklace, but your daughter has to miss her class trip? Some father you are. MARK(shrugging)Too bad she can't miss out on your loser genes! Don’t forget, you quit your job to be a full-time mom. EMILYYou begged me to quit teaching to raise our kid. Now I’m the loser? ANNASweetheart, a failure’s a failure. You gave up your career for him. Now you’re worthless. EMILYShut up. You don’t get to judge me, home wrecker. Emily raises a hand to slap Anna, but Mark grabs her wrist and slaps her instead. Emily stomps on Anna’s foot and bolts away. Anna and Mark scream curses. Her phone rings. She fumbles to answer. DAVID (V.O.)Emily! Three scripts to Lucas’s villa, now. He needs to pick a role in thirty minutes. One second late, I'll dock your whole day’s pay! EMILY(rolling her eyes)Got it. On my way.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY5 5

The iron gates swing open. A BUTLER leads Emily inside. Emily hurries with the scripts, almost tripping on the uneven stone path. EMILY(mutters)Rich asshole can’t even fix the path… She reaches the garden. Lucas scrolls his phone. On the phone screen is a DM from the user "OnlyU_Lucas": OBSESSED FAN (V.O.)Lukiepoo, that white suit you wore last week was gorgeous. Next time wear black! It drives me wild. The sunset glazes the pool gold. Lucas sighs, tosses his phone, and dives in. Emily calls out. EMILYMr. Lucas, I’m here to drop off- Lucas bursts from the water, slicking his hair back, droplets sliding from his collarbone down his abs. Emily freezes, staring, throat dry. EMILY (V.O.)God, his body should be illegal. Lucas blinks, surprised. LUCASIt’s you?
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY6 6

Emily snaps back to reality, clears her throat. EMILYHere’s your MV scripts, Mr. Lucas. Please read them. LUCAS (V.O.)She really doesn’t remember me. Lucas frowns, then smirks slightly. He reaches out.

LUCASHand it to me. Emily hesitates, then offers the script. Lucas grabs her wrist and yanks her into the pool. EMILY(struggling)Help! I can’t swim— Lucas pulls her up, arm locking around her waist. Emily instinctively plants her hand on his chest. Their eyes lock. Lucas glances down at her hand and raises a brow. LUCASThrowing yourself at me? Bold move. Emily flushes, quickly looks away, shoves at his chest. EMILYSorry. I'm too old for you. Lucas narrows his eyes, brushing a droplet from the corner of her lips with his thumb. LUCASYou say you’re not interested, but your heartbeat is so fast! Emily blushes deeper. EMILYLet me go. I’ve got work to do. She scrambles out of the pool, clothes dripping, clutching her chest as she rushes off. Lucas watches her retreating figure, memory flooding back.
INT. REHEARSAL ROOM – DAY7 7

Seventeen-year-old Lucas hugs a guitar in the corner. A group of TEENS sneer at him. TEEN A(shoving the guitar back into his arms, loud)That’s, what, your eighth fail? If all you can do is write songs, go home!

TEEN BWith that small-town accent, you think a big label’s gonna sign you? Go back to your cows, hillbilly. Lucas clutches the guitar, jaw tight, silent. EMILY (O.S.)That’s enough! The students freeze, turn. STUDENTSMiss Emily… Emily ignores them. She crouches in front of Lucas. EMILYThey got in because of family connections. You’ll get the role because of hard work. The audience will always remember the ones who really worked for it. She stands, extending a hand. EMILY (CONT'D)Failure doesn’t mean it’s over. You came here to prove you can be better, didn’t you? She stands in the light, hair haloed in gold. Lucas looks up, slowly reaching up to take her hand.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY8 8

LUCAS (V.O.)Eight years. Her words burned into me. Because of her, I gave everything, and I made it here. Lucas lowers his gaze. LUCASShe still sees me as a kid. That’s fine. As long as I can step back into her world… I’ll take my time. He swims to the edge, climbs out with ease, grabs his phone from a lounge chair. ON SCREEN: A DM.

OBSESSED FAN (V.O.)Lukiepoo, you were in my dreams again last night. I love you so much. Please, just reply once… it’s the only reason I can keep going. Expression flat, Lucas deletes it. He dials David, puts it on speaker while drying his hair with a towel. LUCAS(lazily)I’ve made my choice. Emily Carter will be my manager. Tell her she starts tomorrow. DAVID (V.O.)Fine, it’s your call! That crazy fan still sliding in your DMs? LUCASI deleted her DM. What? DAVIDLucas! This is serious! I’m ready to call the cops! LUCAS(flat, dismissive)Okay, okay. Next one she sends, I’ll forward it to you, alright? He hangs up mid-conversation and tosses the phone aside. Snapping his fingers, he looks at the approaching butler with a wicked smile. LUCAS (CONT'D)Go bring Miss Emily back here.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY9 9

Emily reaches the front gate when the butler rushes up with a towel. BUTLERPlease, change into something dry. Mr. Lucas still needs to see you. Emily glances down at her soaked clothes, hesitates, then takes the towel.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY10 10

Emily, now in one of Lucas’s shirts, rolls up the sleeves as she walks. Lucas lounges on a deck chair, robe half-open, abs gleaming in the sunset. LUCAS(looking up)Perfect. I have an offer for you. Be my manager. EMILY(no hesitation)Sorry. I’m not switching clients right now. She turns to leave. LUCASFive grand a month. Emily keeps walking. LUCAS (CONT'D)Plus a year-end bonus. I heard you have a daughter? I'll cover her tuition! Emily freezes. Hesitation flickers across her face.
INT. EMILY'S APARTMENT – DAY11 11

CHLOE sits at the table, sketching a rocket. EMILY(kneeling beside her)I’m sorry, sweetie. I don’t have the money to send you to the observatory trip… Are you mad at me? Chloe reaches up and pets her mom’s head with a smile. CHLOEI know 135 bucks is a lot for us. It’s okay, Mom. Honestly, I didn’t really want to go.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY12 12
Emily presses a hand to her chest, biting her lip.

Her phone rings, cutting her off. She answers. DAVIDEmily! Lucas requested you, or he walks. If he breaks contract, you’re paying the penalty! EMILY(shocked)Me?! David, you know I- DAVIDShut it! Do you know how many people would kill for this job? Eight A.M. tomorrow. Don’t be late! He hangs up. Emily glares, teeth clenched, then whirls back. EMILYFine. But I want cash daily. No overtime. LUCAS(chuckling)Deal. Emily signs the papers and hands them over. Lucas scans them, nods, and tosses them aside. LUCAS (CONT'D)(grinning, opening his robe)First task. Right now.(points at his shoulder)After-sun lotion. Even it out. EMILY(glaring)You’re serious? LUCAS(shrugging)A manager should handle everything. Emily exhales, sits beside him, squeezes lotion into her hand, and touches his shoulder.
EMILY (V.O.)His skin’s hotter than I thought. Harder too. Such a perfect body is wasted on such an asshole. Lucas closes his eyes, his breathing heavier.
EXT. LUCAS' VILLA – DAY13 13

Lucas shivers under Emily’s touch, barely able to maintain his composure. LUCASAlright… you passed. Be here on time tomorrow. Lucas opens his eyes, puts on his robe, and leaves, leaving Emily staring, speechless.
INT. RECORDING STUDIO – DAY15 15

LUCASI want seven iced Americanos, all at two degrees difference each. I need them in the studio in exactly one hour. EMILYPlanning to open a coffee shop? LUCASTimer starts… now. Emily exhales sharply and jogs down the hall, teeth clenched. Lucas’ smile fades, a touch hurt. LUCAS (V.O.)She forgot me… might as well charge a little interest. Fair enough.
INT. VAN – DAY16 16
Lucas gestures for Emily to get in. He slides into the driver’s seat, locks the doors, and leans toward her. Emily instinctively crosses her arms, leaning back.

EMILYStop. You’re my boss, and younger than me! If anyone saw us, it’d look really bad. Lucas smirks mischievously, tossing 200 posters into her lap and a pen into her hand. Emily groans, and signs them. LUCAS (V.O.)Since she thinks I’m too young, I’ll be as childish as I want.
INT. COMPANY – DAY17 17
Lucas, in a sharp suit, pauses mid-step, lifts a foot. Emily walks behind him, puzzled. Lucas points to his untied shoelace. Emily crouches, rolling her eyes, tying it for him.
INT. COMPANY – DAY19 19

Lucas takes a couple of steps, then stops again. LUCASWait. Go to ML and pick up my suit. Charity gala starts at seven tonight. EMILYML? That’s eighty miles to go there and back. I can't be back by seven. LUCAS(raising an eyebrow)Unless you want to risk breaking your manager contract… EMILY(gritting her teeth, on the edge)Don’t push me too far- Her words cut off as her phone rings. She snatches it up. SCHOOL TEACHER (V.O.)Mrs. Carter? Chloe’s in trouble. Please come immediately! Emily’s eyes go wide.
INT. TEACHER’S OFFICE – DAY20 20

Emily bursts in. Chloe stands in the corner, her lip scraped, school uniform collar askew. EMILYSweetie, are you okay? Chloe bursts into tears and clings to her mother. CHLOEMom- Emily pats her back, face full of worry. MRS. PETERSON and her SON stands nearby, her arms crossed, shouting. MRS. PETERSONLook at my son! Your daughter scratched him up! You need to pay his medical bills, emotional damages, every penny! MRS. THOMPSON’s SON is crying too, holding a scraped arm. MRS. THOMPSONFatherless kids are wild! You owe us three grand today, or we’re suing you! Emily wipes Chloe’s tears. EMILYChloe, what happened? CHLOE(tears streaming)They said I have no dad, and mom doesn’t want me because I couldn’t even afford the observatory trip… and I’m a freak. They pushed me first. Emily glares at the teachers, furious. EMILYDid you hear that? My daughter doesn’t start fights for no reason. Did you check the cameras?

TEACHERThat was in a blind spot for the cameras. The school doesn’t want a big scandal. Either you pay up, or according to regulations, Chloe will be expelled. Emily stands, enraged. EMILYThis isn’t my daughter’s fault! TEACHER(impatient)Mrs. Carter, you know how competitive this school is. Keep fighting, and it’ll hurt you both. Emily grits her teeth, walks to the door, hesitates, then calls Mark. EMILYChloe’s in trouble. Need three grand. Lend it to me. I’ll pay you back next week. MARK (V.O.)Three grand? Listen, you produced a liability, and now you want me to pay? Dream on! EMILY(gritting teeth)She’s still your daughter! MARK (V.O.)(laughing)How about you spend a night with me, and I might give a discount? Emily slams the phone down, furious. MRS. PETERSONFatherless kids have no manners. The PARENTS laugh. Mrs. Peterson's son blows a raspberry. YOUNG PETERSONFreak! Freak! Your mom can’t even afford the observatory! Go count stars at the dump! Emily kneels beside Chloe, about to speak, when a deep male voice cuts through the room.
LUCAS (O.S.)Who said my daughter is fatherless? Everyone looks to the doorway. Lucas stands there, mask on, hat low, one hand in his pocket.
INT. TEACHER’S OFFICE – DAY21 21

Lucas walks up to Emily, draping a hand over her shoulder. LUCASSorry I’m late. My flight was late. Emily freezes for a moment. Mrs. Peterson eyes Lucas up and down, scoffing. MRS. PETERSONWell, who’s this? LUCASI’m Chloe’s father.(turns to Emily)Honey, you okay? Emily stiffens for a beat, then leans in slightly, whispering, curious. EMILYHow did you even find me? LUCAS(winks)Let’s just say I care about my manager. Lucas looks down at Chloe, scoops her up, and pulls out the tickets. LUCAS (CONT'D)Sweetheart, I brought you observatory tickets. Next week, we’re counting stars together. Chloe’s tears vanish instantly. She gasps, stunned, then throws her arms around Lucas’ neck. CHLOEI love you, Dad! Emily shakes her head, smiling helplessly.

MRS. THOMPSON(frowning)You still owe us— Lucas glares at her. LUCASFine. First, apologize to my daughter. Then explain who told you to say all those things. Otherwise… you’ll soon find out who you’re messing with.
INT. TEACHER’S OFFICE – DAY22 22

MRS. PETERSON(laughing)Threatening me? Dressed so fancy? Bet this is Emily’s paid boyfriend. No wonder she rushed to ditch her ex, she's a real cougar, huh? MRS. THOMPSONExactly. Even if you're just trying to trick our kids, at least hire a decent actor! Young man, are you even at drinking age? MRS. PETERSON(points at Lucas’ shoes)Limited edition? Definitely fake. Poor peasants can’t even afford good knockoffs. The mothers and kids laugh. Their phones start buzzing. MR. PETERSON (V.O.)Our deals with Starry Globe Entertainment are canceled! We’re going bankrupt! Who the hell did you piss off? MR. THOMPSON (V.O.)Starry Globe pulled out! Our stocks are plummeting! Bank wants the margin now! This is all your fault! We’re getting a divorce! Their faces drain of color. Phones drop.

MRS. PETERSON(disbelief, looking at Lucas)Could it be… you…? The PRINCIPAL rushes in, panting, waving at the group. PRINCIPALThe school knows the truth. You kids apologize to Chloe immediately! TEACHER(shocked)Principal, the kids were just messing around- PRINCIPAL(points at teacher)You, you're encouraging bullying? You’re fired. The teacher pales as two security guards escort them out. young Peterson and young Thompson, pushed by their moms, reluctantly step forward and bow. YOUNG PETERSON / YOUNG THOMPSONWe’re sorry. They drag their kids away. The principal turns to Emily, bowing slightly. PRINCIPALMrs. Carter, the school will strengthen security. Chloe will not suffer again. Otherwise, the entire board will personally apologize. Emily is stunned. LUCASYou better make sure that happens. Lucas takes Chloe’s hand and Emily’s, leading them out.
INT. CAR – DAY23 23
Emily leans back in the passenger seat, sighing. EMILY (V.O.)Maybe Chloe really does need a dad to protect her.

(glances at Lucas)He seems so cold on the surface, I didn’t expect him of all people to step up for me when it matters. EMILY(grateful)Thanks for today. Really.(serious)But next time… please don’t intervene. You know how many rumors would start if the press heard about it. Lucas removes his mask, smiling. LUCASRumors? Dating, or secretly married with a kid?(glances at Chloe)Aren’t you the one who treated me like a kid? Scared to be caught in a scandal with a kid? Emily hesitates, silent, staring out the window. LUCAS (V.O.)How can I prove you can rely on me too? Chloe suddenly leans forward from the back seat, eyes widening as she sees Lucas’ face. CHLOELucas! It’s really you!
INT. CAR – DAY24 24

CHLOE(excited)Mom, it’s Lucas! I'm your biggest fan! Can I take a selfie with you? Lucas deliberately tilts his hat back, flashing his signature smile and winks at her. LUCASOf course. But your mom has to pinky swear to treat me a little better from now on.

Chloe turns to Emily, hands clasped in a pleading gesture. CHLOEMom, please? He was so cool today! Lucas smirks at Emily, raising an eyebrow. Emily sighs, pulling her hand back reluctantly. EMILYChloe, buckle your seatbelt first… CHLOEMom, please! Just one selfie! I’ll skip ice cream for a whole month! EMILYFine… Lucas immediately reclines the seat, makes space, scoops Chloe onto his lap with one arm, and holds up the phone with the other. Emily is in the frame reluctantly. Lucas looks at the photo, satisfied, and shakes the phone at her. LUCAS(mouthing, smug)Perfect. Post it. People will think we’re a real family, right? Chloe sits, hugging the phone, grinning like an idiot. EMILY(to Lucas, scolding)Shut up!(to Chloe, calm)Sweetie, let’s head home now. Chloe nods. Lucas steps on the gas, and they drive off.
INT. BACKSTAGE – EVENT HALL – DAY25 25

Lucas and Emily just walk in when an assistant rushes up with a pink envelope. ASSISTANTLucas, someone at the entrance insisted this be handed to you personally. The assistant leaves. Emily, holding the schedule, glances at the envelope.

EMILYAnother obsessed fan? I’ll go check the stage positions. Don’t worry. LUCASRelax. Lucas opens the envelope. It’s another creepy fan letter, pages filled with dense writing. His expression darkens. LUCAS (CONT'D)(low, muttering)Unbelievable… He rips the letter into pieces, tossing them into the trash. EMILY (O.S.)Lucas! You can come over now! Lucas exhales, pats his face, restores his composure, and heads toward Emily.
INT. EVENT HALL – DAY26 26

Cameras flash, screams erupt. Lucas stands on stage, holding the microphone, calm and practiced. LUCASThank you all for supporting me. I'm so happy to see you all here… His eyes sweep over the front row, locking on a girl in a red dress. Suddenly, he remembers a line in the letter. OBSESSED FAN (V.O.)If you dare look at the girl in red in the front row, I’ll gouge her eyes out… LUCAS (V.O.)She’s here? Lucas instinctively steps back slightly, trembling. Emily notices immediately and rushes onto the stage. EMILYLucas! Are you- Lucas steadies himself. Emily trips on a step, stumbling and sliding along the marble floor straight between his legs. The crowd goes silent, then cameras flash again. Emily is frozen, mind blank. In the corner, the OBSESSED FAN, wearing a mask and baseball cap glares at them, eyes filled with menace.
INT. EVENT HALL – DAY27 27

Lucas reacts instantly, stepping forward and bending down to help Emily up, his expression calm and composed. LUCASJust a little hiccup there. Let’s move on to the next segment, Q&A! Who’s got a question? The crowd erupts, microphones shooting up. The host hurries forward to take control. HOSTAlright! Let’s start with this fan right here! Applause and screams fill the hall again. Emily, embarrassed, covers her face and scurries off the stage.
INT. OFFICE – DAY28 28

Emily sits at her desk, scrolling through trending topics on her phone: #LucasManagerStageSlip. The comments are full of mockery and memes. Rebecca even sent a string of laughing emojis. Emily buries her face in her hands. EMILYOh my god… This is mortifying… how am I supposed to live with this?
EXT. LUCAS’ VILLA – DAY29 29

Lucas lounges with his phone, replaying the video of Emily slipping on stage. A grin spreads across his face. LUCASSo smooth even when she trips… how is she this cute? He screenshots a few frames, editing them into ridiculous memes, and sends them to Emily with a mischievous smile. After sending, he stares at their chat, gradually growing thoughtful. LUCAS (V.O.)She saved me again. Was it just because I’m her client, or… does she like me just a little too?

His face lights up with a spark of excitement. He sets the phone aside, jumps into the pool, and swims several laps, carefree. Emily storms up, yelling. EMILYLucas! Delete that meme right now! No response. Her eyes land on the phone on the table, and she snatches it up. The screen lights up. She freezes. Lucas already set the ridiculous, ugly meme as his screensaver. EMILY (CONT'D)(shaking, furious)You… bastard… what have you done! Suddenly, the phone rings. Emily frowns at the unknown number, instinctively reaching to answer. EMILY (CONT'D)Who could this be?
EXT. LUCAS’ VILLA – DAY30 30

Water splashes behind her. Emily instinctively turns. Lucas snatches the phone and holds it high. LUCASIf you're cringing so much, there’s no way I’m deleting it. EMILYDelete it! Right now! She reaches for it but accidentally stumbles forward, landing squarely in Lucas’ arms. LUCAS(raising an eyebrow)Seduction tactic? EMILY(pushes him away)Lucas, you’re hopeless! She glares at him, teeth gritted, and spins to walk off. LUCASThanks. I know you went on stage to help me.

Emily nearly trips, stops, and glances back. Lucas catches up quickly, and they stand face to face. LUCAS (CONT'D)(sincerely)But I wanted to know, was it just professional instinct to protect the artist? Or do you still see me as a kid? Or maybe… LUCAS (V.O.)…is there a tiniest chance it’s because you have feelings for me? Lucas leans in, aiming for a kiss. Emily’s lashes flutter, her gaze locked on his, then she leans closer, her nose almost brushing his face. Lucas freezes, his Adam’s apple bobbing. LUCAS (V.O.) (CONT'D)Does she want to kiss me too? He instinctively closes his eyes, lashes trembling. Emily notices, and her fingertip brushes a piece of glitter stuck near his eye. EMILYA bit of glitter on set fell on your face, almost got in your eye! Lucas opens his eyes, ears pink, expression flustered. He takes a step back, retreating like he’s fleeing. LUCASI just remembered… there’s something else I need to do. Emily watches his hurried retreat, suppressing a smile. EMILY(softly, to herself)Did he seriously think I was going to kiss him? Her phone rings. REBECCA (V.O.)Hey babe! I set up a blind date for you, tomorrow at 9! Don’t miss it! Her mind flashes back to Chloe being bullied at school, and Mark’s mocking words echo in her head.
EMILYMaybe Chloe does need a new dad… Fine, send me the address. Meanwhile, Lucas, a few steps away, perks up. LUCAS (V.O.)A blind date?!
INT. RESTAURANT – DAY31 31

Emily is dressed up, seated by the window. She takes out her phone to text her best friend, Rebecca, eyes constantly scanning the restaurant. Lucas, wearing a cap and mask, sits directly behind her. TOBY (40) walks in wearing a simple but sharp suit, heading toward Emily’s table (table #7). TOBY(extending hand, smiling)Hi, Emily. I’m Toby. It's an honor to meet you. EMILY(shaking his hand)Hello, Toby. Nice to meet you too. They sit. The mood is light and conversational. TOBYYou’re a talent manager, right? I hear you work with a lot of celebrities. Must be interesting. EMILYYes, it’s fulfilling, and I love what I do. Do you like kids? TOBYOf course! I’ve always wanted a daughter! She must be adorable. EMILY(relieved)Chloe is a really sweet kid. Lucas leans back in his chair, tapping his fingers on his knee, his expression darkening. Toby gets up. TOBYExcuse me, I need to wash my hands.

He walks away. Emily watches him leave. As soon as he’s gone, Lucas rises and leans in close, voice low and dangerous. LUCASHow can you chat with him so easily? Do you even know what kind of man he is? EMILY(surprised)Why are you here? I’m just your manager, this isn’t your business. LUCAS(gets up, teeth gritted)Fine. I’m leaving. Lucas opens the door, and catches Toby there on his phone. TOBY(mocking)Mom, don’t worry! She’s forty and in showbiz, she definitely has money. Once I win her over, the house goes in my name, then I'll dump her. Lucas’ eyes turn icy. He spins on his heel and strides back inside. Toby pushes the door open, smiling, but Lucas is already in front of Emily. EMILYYou again- Without hesitation, Lucas cups the back of her neck and kisses her on the lips.
INT. RESTAURANT – DAY32 32

Emily’s eyes widen in shock. She yanks back and slaps Lucas. EMILY(angry)Are you crazy?! Who gave you the right to do that?! Lucas freezes, stunned. Toby rushes forward. TOBYYou have a boyfriend and still came to a blind date? The fuck?

I just wanted to snag an ATM, and surprise, it belongs to someone! Emily’s face instantly hardens. EMILYSo you were just here to make a quick buck. TOBYWhat else? You're almost forty, divorced, and dragging a kid along. You think I actually care? Lucas’ anger flares. He grabs Toby by the collar, eyes cold and lethal. LUCASSay one more word insulting her, and I’ll make sure you can’t set foot in Los Angeles. Toby scoffs at first, then looks up, finally registering Lucas’ face. His eyes widen in shock, then gleam with mischievous amusement. TOBYYou… you are- Emily snaps back to reality and pulls Lucas away. EMILYYou’re right. I am almost forty. But I know myself better than I did at twenty. At least I don’t need to put others down to feel superior. She notices whispers around them and quickly grabs Lucas’ cap, plopping it on his head. She grabs his arm and pulls him out of the restaurant. In the corner, a masked woman snaps pictures, teeth clenched. OBSESSED FAN(through gritted teeth)Bitch! How dare you touch my man! You’ll pay for this!
INT. CAR – DAY33 33
Emily glances at Lucas’ cheek, still marked red from her slap. She instinctively reaches out, then hesitates.

EMILY(soft, remorseful)I… I’m sorry. Let me put some ointment on it. Panicking, she looks around for supplies. Lucas retrieves a first-aid kit from the back seat and hands it to her. LUCAS(coldly)Think this will make me forgive you? No chance. He leans closer as she applies ointment to his cheek. EMILYI already told you, if you were photographed just now, you’d be on the front page tomorrow! LUCAS(nonchalant)I don’t care. But didn’t you learn from your past? Rushing into a relationship again? EMILY(sighs)It’s for Chloe. You saw what happened at school. I can live without a husband, but Chloe needs a father. LUCASIf you insist on finding someone for your daughter… The dating market is basically a mess right now. Why not… consider me? EMILY(laughing, incredulous)Lucas?! Are you insane?! You?! LUCASI don’t see the problem. Chloe seems to like me too. EMILY(amused, exasperated)That’s… completely different! Emily moves to get out of the car. Lucas grabs her hand and gently pins her back into the passenger seat.
INT. CAR – DAY34 34

Lucas’ phone suddenly rings. Emily glances at his screen. Lucas frowns, mutters under his breath, and releases Emily. LUCASDamn it- He reluctantly answers. DAVID (V.O.)Lucas, get over here now! There’s a problem with the collab single! He hangs up. Emily puts her seatbelt on and looks at a text. EMILYYou go to the meeting. I need to stop by the office to grab a package. No idea who sent it. LUCAS(alert)A package? I’m coming with you. Before Emily can object, Lucas guns the engine and heads for the office.
INT. COMPANY - OFFICE – DAY35 35
